items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Or else I'll look it up later. Yeah. I'd like to talk to his wife. But you mean, uh, Miss Renee's? Yes, uh, Mrs. Mary.

ctx.x: No, I don't know Joe's address. I don't know his address. But, uh, I know his, I know Renee's wife's address and she might could tell you.

Yeah, she'd probably know too. If you have it in your mind, you can just say it now and we'll have it on the tape and we can check on it. Or else I'll look it up later. Yeah. I'd like to talk to his wife. But you mean, uh, Miss Renee's? Yes, uh, Mrs. Mary.

Well, my wife, my wife could tell you right now her address. We'll get it done after a while. Yeah. Well, anyway, after I left, after I left, after I left, I went to, uh, Sam Morgan's band. But I was just working in somebody else's place. I wasn't supposed to be in my place, but I played with his band one year. Sam Morgan's. You see. I played one night club called, they call it the Humming Boys. Oh yeah. George Gaynor told me about that place. Well, I, I, I take George's place in there. George, uh, uh, uh, got…
